LanguageData.CC_SetNote_RegionFortunes: Each town within reach has a fortune the world's events move, shown in its panel and its people's words.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_RegionFaces: A new town within reach has a founder, founding families and a reason, told in the news, its talk and a letter.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RegionFortunes_Tip: Every town of a people within the region map's reach of your homes (the nearest 40 for each home) has a prosperity from 0 to 100. A town first seen starts at 50, less on poor land and while its people are in hard times; a new town starts at 30. The world's events move it, all of it at the event's own town and half at its people's other towns, over the event's first five days (a plague 20 down, a fair 8 up); a war near it wears it down; and it drifts back toward 50 by 0.3 a day. Its panel on the region map says how it stands and what moved it, and its people speak of it. Off: nothing is moved or shown, and the records are kept.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RegionFaces_Tip: A town begun or built within the region map's reach (by Faction Territories and Vassalage, or by Rimfolk's own world events) gets a founder of its people, two founding families, the town its settlers came from and a reason read from the land. The colony news tells it once when begun and once when built, in place of the other mod's own message. Its founder is its head for its first year, its people speak of it, and a town within about 15 tiles sends a letter from its founder (one a season at most). Off: no founder is made and nothing is told, and the records are kept.

LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Label_Tribal: Word from the new hearth at {TOWN}
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Tribal: {FOUNDER} speaks for the new hearth at {TOWN}, {WHERE} of {COLONY}. We came out from {MOTHER} with our families and our fire, and we wanted you to hear it from us before you heard it on the wind.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Tribal_NoMother: {FOUNDER} speaks for the new hearth at {TOWN}, {WHERE} of {COLONY}. We came with our families and our fire, and we wanted you to hear it from us before you heard it on the wind.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Medieval: To the folk of {COLONY}, from {FOUNDER}, {TITLE} of {TOWN}, greeting. We have raised our first roofs {WHERE} of you, having come out from {MOTHER}, and would be good neighbors if you will have us.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Medieval_NoMother: To the folk of {COLONY}, from {FOUNDER}, {TITLE} of {TOWN}, greeting. We have raised our first roofs {WHERE} of you, and would be good neighbors if you will have us.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Industrial: {FOUNDER} here, {TITLE} of {TOWN}, the new settlement {WHERE} of you. We came out from {MOTHER} this season and we're putting up walls as fast as we can cut the timber. I thought you should know who your neighbors are.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Industrial_NoMothe: {FOUNDER} here, {TITLE} of {TOWN}, the new settlement {WHERE} of you. We're putting up walls as fast as we can cut the timber, and I thought you should know who your neighbors are.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Spacer: This is {FOUNDER}, {TITLE} of the new settlement at {TOWN}, {WHERE} of your colony. Our charter is filed, our first habitats are sealed, and most of our people came out from {MOTHER}. We would like to keep a channel open with you.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Spacer_NoMother: This is {FOUNDER}, {TITLE} of the new settlement at {TOWN}, {WHERE} of your colony. Our charter is filed and our first habitats are sealed. We would like to keep a channel open with you.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Empire: {FOUNDER}, {TITLE}, holds {TOWN} for the Empire from this season, {WHERE} of your settlement. The household came out from {MOTHER}, and it is proper that the nearest of our neighbors hear it from us first.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Open_Empire_NoMother: {FOUNDER}, {TITLE}, holds {TOWN} for the Empire from this season, {WHERE} of your settlement. It is proper that the nearest of our neighbors hear it from us first.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_refugees: Most of us lost our homes when our old town was given up. This is a fresh start, and we mean to make it last.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_ruin: There were old walls here when we came, and we have built on them. Whoever lived here before chose the place well.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_mother: {MOTHER} has done well and grown crowded, and the young families wanted land of their own.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_road: We chose the place for the road: whatever comes along it will stop with us now.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_river: We chose the place for the river: water for the fields, and a way down to the world.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_coast: We chose the place for the sea at our door.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_hills: We chose the place for the shelter of the hills.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Why_land: We chose the place for the land itself, which is better than it looks.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Deed: {PEOPLE} still speak of how you {DEED}. It is good to settle near people like that.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Wrong: We know there is bad blood between you and {PEOPLE}, since you {WRONG}. We had no part in it, and we would rather keep it that way.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Letter_Close_Industrial: Drop by if you're ever out our way. {FOUNDER}
